com.saicone.ezlib

Class Ezlib

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.saicone.ezlib.Ezlib

  • public class Ezlib
extends java.lang.Object

    Ezlib class to load, download & append libraries into class path.
    Uses a gradle-like dependency format on load methods.

      • download

        public java.io.File download(java.lang.String dependency,
                             java.lang.String repository)
                      throws java.io.IOException,
                             java.lang.IllegalArgumentException
        Download a dependency using gradle-like format (group:artifact:version) from repository url.
        Parameters:
        dependency - Dependency to load.
        repository - Repository to download the dependency from it.
        Returns:
        A file representing the downloaded dependency.
        Throws:
        java.io.IOException - If any error occurs with the download.
        java.lang.IllegalArgumentException - If the dependency is not formatted correctly.
